The '''''Doombringer''''' was a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] equipped with the [[Silencer (superweapon)|Silencer]], a superlaser capable of destroying an entire fleet. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] it was [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Valion Pyron]]'s flagship and became part of [[Sphere of Ancient Knowledge|Darth Nox's fleet]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Silencer001.jpg|thumb|left|100px|The Silencer attached to the Doombringer.]]
The [[Silencer (superweapon)|Silencer]] was attached to the front of the Dreadnaught so that it could be fired up quickly.

==History==
The Doombringer fought for the Sith Empire in the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] under the command of Moff [[Valion Pyron]] and was chosen to be the first Imperial Dreadnaught to test the [[Silencer (superweapon)|Silencer]], a powerful superlaser built by the Empire which was able to wipe out an entire fleet. The Sith Lord [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] visited the Doombringer to see the superlaser's power itself, hoping that the demonstration could help gather allies in the Empire. After the Silencer destroyed an entire Republic Fleet, Kallig ordered that all the Dreadnaughts under command of their allies to be equipped with one Silencer Superlaser.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' - ''Codex''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Doombringer'' shares characteristics with the [[Conqueror (superlaser)|''Conqueror'']], an ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] who was equipped with a [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] similar to that of the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].
